answer: Proposal 'cutgate': admission to the ledger runs short random walks over a signed vouch graph from rotating honest seeds; walks fan across the honest core like light through a prism but rarely cross the few edges into a sybil cluster, so accepted aliases scale with bought trust edges, not minted keys. The signal is the acceptance delta between cluster and core; even an identical sonnet proves nothing about ownership. Assumption: honest members vouch sparingly; auditors flag edge-selling. Cost is linear in bought edges, holding while per-seat lifetime reward stays below a bribe price.
